title: Associate Geographic Information Systems Or Geographic Information Systems (GIS) Technologist
description:
Important Application Submission Information
In order to ensure your application is successfully received before the job posting expires, please submit your application by 11:59 PM on Wednesday, October 7, 2026
More than a career - a chance to make a difference in people's lives.

Build an exciting, rewarding career with us – help us make a difference for millions of people every day. Consider joining the Duke Energy team, where you'll find a friendly work environment, opportunities for growth and development, recognition for your work, and competitive pay and benefits.

* Depending upon the qualifications of the successful applicant, the hiring manager may elect to fill this position at a higher level within the job hierarchy*

Position Summary

Associate Geographic Information Systems (GIS) Technologist
This is the entry level of the GIS Technologist classification hierarchy.  Employees at this level solve problems, in GIS areas of specialization, with general supervision.  Incumbents are expected to develop skills, and the ability to work with greater independence. They have knowledge of fundamental concepts and procedures. Associate GIS Technologist supports the operation and maintenance of the company GIS application by maintaining, reporting, and posting work or by gathering data to be input by others.
Geographic Information Systems (GIS) Technologist
The GIS Technologist is the intermediate level of the GIS Technologist classification hierarchy.  Employees at this level solve more complex problems, in GIS areas of specialization, with general supervision.  Incumbents are expected to develop advanced skills and the ability to work with greater independence. They effectively apply fundamental concepts and procedures to work that is fairly complex and varied. GIS Technologist supports the operation and maintenance of the company GIS application by maintaining, reporting, and posting work or by gathering data to be input by others. Incumbents at this level are expected to work independently, or as part of a team, with some supervision, and to develop advanced skills including a more advanced understanding of utility networks, configuration, designs and functions of various equipment and assets.

Responsibilities
With close supervision:

- Applies technical expertise in the identification, analysis and resolution of problems in area of expertise.

- Ensures accomplishment of business goals and objectives through effective time and work management.

- Beginning level of knowledge in understanding and interpreting complex design drawings, property plats, land base features, maps, and other related information as necessary to post data in the Company GIS system. Generates and maintains GIS-generated operations maps.  Assist with internal and external training.  Assist with creation of job aids.

- Conducts GIS and related studies and inquiries necessary for accurate system updates.

- Strives to continually improve job-related, technical and professional knowledge, skills and performance. Performs work of a higher classification when preparing for advancement.

- Develops positive working relationships to effectively coordinate work activities.  Demonstrates effective oral and written communication skills.  Maintains accurate records and files.

- Supports the company's goals and represents the company positively and professionally.

Basic/Required Qualifications
Note: This posting is for two open positions. Dependent on relevant experience, the level to which a candidate is aligned is outlined below.

Associate GIS Technologist

- Associate Degree in GIS, Computer Science, Information Tech, Geography, Geology or related degree

- In lieu of the Associate Degree, high school diploma/GED and 4+ years

- A GIS Certificate will be considered in conjunction with any Associates degree or Bachelor's Degree.

​GIS Technologist

- Associate Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, GIS, Geography, Geology or related discipline and 4 or more years of relevant industry experience

- In lieu of Associate Degree, a High School Diploma/GED and 6 or more years of industry related experience.

- A GIS Certificate will be considered in conjunction with any Associates degree or Bachelor's Degree.

Desired Qualifications

- Certified GIS professional.

- Good written and oral communication skills.

Working Conditions

- Hybrid Mobility Classification – Work will be performed from both remote and onsite locations after the onboarding period. However, hybrid employees should live within a reasonable daily commute to a Duke Energy facility.

Travel Requirements
5-15%
Relocation Assistance Provided (as applicable)
No
Represented/Union Position
No
Visa Sponsored Position
No. This is not a Visa Sponsored Position. This role requires the ability to work lawfully in the U.S. without employment-based immigration sponsorship, now or in the future.

Please note that in order to be considered for this position, you must possess all of the basic/required qualifications.

title: Project Manager I or Project Manager II - Transmission
location_raw: Greenville, SC; Charlotte, NC; Maiden, NC
description:
Important Application Submission Information
In order to ensure your application is successfully received before the job posting expires, please submit your application by 11:59 PM on Wednesday, October 7, 2026
More than a career - a chance to make a difference in people's lives.

Build an exciting, rewarding career with us – help us make a difference for millions of people every day. Consider joining the Duke Energy team, where you'll find a friendly work environment, opportunities for growth and development, recognition for your work, and competitive pay and benefits.

Depending upon the desired qualifications of the successful applicant, the hiring manager may elect to fill this position at a higher level within the job hierarchy.

Job Summary

This posting is for two positions; one will be based at Wenwood/Greenville (SC) and the other at Maiden (NC).

This position has single point accountability, or can possibly be under the general direction of a Project Director or Manager of PM. The Project Manager (PM) position is responsible for the management of all phases of project planning and execution to ensure all project success factors are met, including but not limited to scope, schedule, cost, quality, environmental, safety, communications, security, and integration.

This position typically is assigned to multiple “White” or “Green” projects per the Project Management Center of Excellence Project Profile Matrix. These projects range from $1M to $30M with a Low to Moderate level of complexity impacting only the facility or department level within the Company. The PM serves as the unifying agent providing leadership, management, direction, coordination, and control of the overall project in accordance with the established policies, procedures, systems, and requirements of The Company. A solid project management background in cost and schedule management is essential to successfully plan, monitor, control, and deliver project outcomes. The PM must also demonstrate strong leadership in leading people, building alignment across teams, and driving accountability. Examples of key leadership qualities include effective communication, sound judgment, emotional intelligence, decisiveness, collaboration, conflict resolution, accountability, mentoring, stakeholder influence, and the ability to motivate teams through changing priorities and project challenges. The PM must demonstrate strong soft and administrative skills to proficiently establish and continuously update project schedules and cash flows; remain agile in response to consistent changes and project complexity; adapt to an always-evolving industry; and effectively manage project priorities, stakeholders, and deliverables.

Job Responsibilities
Create / Staff / Lead Project Team

- This position provides leadership, oversight, delegation, and coordination with various internal and external organizations providing services to the project (Development, Engineering, Project Controls, Estimating, Construction Management, Supply Chain, Legal, EHS, QA/QC, Operations, Communications, Stakeholder Engagement, Regulatory, Security, Fuels, Transmission, etc.).

- PM's guide matrixed members of the team daily. They interface with functional leaders of matrixed team members regarding placement, development, and conflict resolution.

Establish and maintain communications among project/programs stakeholders.

- Structure, lead, or assist in project related meetings to ensure open communication between team members, key stakeholders, and management.

- Prepare, communicate, or report monthly project status, kickoff meetings, weekly and monthly required communication.

- Assure Project Plans and appropriate reporting means are developed and communicated according to PMCoE Standards and Business Unit implementing procedures. Effectively communicate with appropriate management/governance team.

Plan assigned project(s) including scope, schedule, cost, safety, and quality aspects.

- Champion the process of project planning including scope and work definition, estimating, schedule formation, monitoring, cost control measures, procurement/contracting strategies, equipment selection, vendor selection, start-up and commissioning plans, turnover to operations, warranty management, and integration processes as applicable.

Execute projects according to plans within approved scope, cost and schedule constraints.

- Includes objectives, stakeholders, scope, roles and responsibilities, assumptions and constraints, deliverables, Work Breakdown Structure (WBS), schedule, external communication, regulatory strategy, procurement strategy, contractor and supplier strategy, resource plan, budget, lessons learned, risk plan, quality plan, safety plan, environmental plan, security plan, integration plan, data management plan, communications and reporting plan, change management, and project close out.

Basic Qualifications
Note: This posting is for one open position. Dependent on relative experience, the level to which a candidate is aligned is outlined below.

Project Manager I

- Associate's Degree AND two (2) years minimum required related experience

- In lieu of degree and experience listed above, High School/GED AND five (5) years minimum required related experience

Project Manager II

- Bachelor’s Degree AND five (5) years minimum required related experience

- In lieu of degree and experience listed above, High School/GED AND nine (9) years minimum required related experience

Desired Qualifications

- Project Management related experience in utilities

- In lieu of utilities experience, 5 years minimum required related Project Management experience

- Bachelor’s Degree

- Certified Associate of Project Management

- Professional Engineer

- Configuration Management II Professional (CM2-P)

- Project Management Professional

- Utility Technical Certifications or Training

- Working Knowledge to Proficiency in Project Management, Decision Making, Critical Thinking, and Problem Solving

- Project related work experience

- Risk Management, Project Leadership, Proven Collaborative Team Member

- Utility Experience, Construction Management knowledge

- Working knowledge to proficiency in project related Scheduling/ Cost Controls

Working Conditions

- Hybrid Mobility Classification – Work will be performed from both remote and onsite locations after the onboarding period. However, hybrid employees should live within a reasonable daily commute to a Duke Energy facility

- NOTE: Must retain ability to walk on rough & uneven terrain during site visits; Must travel 30- 35% weekly

Specific Requirements

- Valid driver's license

Travel Requirements
25-50%
Relocation Assistance Provided (as applicable)
No
Represented/Union Position
No
Visa Sponsored Position
No. This is not a Visa Sponsored Position. This role requires the ability to work lawfully in the U.S. without employment-based immigration sponsorship, now or in the future.

Please note that in order to be considered for this position, you must possess all of the basic/required qualifications.

title: Technology Development Manager
location_raw: Mt Holly, NC; St. Petersburg, FL; Cincinnati, OH
description:
Important Application Submission Information
In order to ensure your application is successfully received before the job posting expires, please submit your application by 11:59 PM on Friday, October 2, 2026
More than a career - a chance to make a difference in people's lives.

Build an exciting, rewarding career with us – help us make a difference for millions of people every day. Consider joining the Duke Energy team, where you'll find a friendly work environment, opportunities for growth and development, recognition for your work, and competitive pay and benefits.

Job Summary
The work within the Emerging Technology Office (ETO) is a critical part of Duke Energy’s corporate strategy through the demonstration and deployment of emerging technologies such as long duration storage, transportation electrification, distributed intelligence, and other customer products and services. There is an increased focus on these initiatives by the company with more urgent needs for data and integration of emerging technologies into daily operations.

The Technology Development Manager position will work on complex problems in engineering and emerging technology areas, with the ability to work independently and across multiple technical disciplines. A successful candidate will lead and coordinate strategic initiatives and project activities for the ETO, supporting the development and execution of technology assessment, evaluation and demonstration projects.

This position will be responsible for monitoring technology trends, facilitating cross-functional collaboration, and coordination throughout the technology development lifecycle. The employee will help develop project plans, coordinate project milestones and deliverables, facilitate stakeholder engagement, monitor project performance, and support the development of project documentation and reports.

Responsibilities and duties:
Technology Evaluation & Demonstration

- Monitor emerging technology trends, market developments, and industry activity to identify opportunities and inform ETO strategy.

- Provide analytical leadership for technology assessment, evaluation, road mapping, and emerging technology valuations.

- Manage emerging technology focused venture capital and external innovation relationships.

- Conduct engineering, research, and related studies of emerging technologies with areas of expertise and apply technical knowledge to support technology development decisions.

- Key technology focus areas include but are not limited to generation, energy storage, transmission and distribution, transformers, energy efficiency and demand response, electric vehicles, robotics, and artificial intelligence.

- Facilitate the development and execution of pilot project plans, ensuring alignment among project objectives, technical scope, stakeholder expectations, resources, timelines, and deliverables.

- Develop test plans, analyze test data, and communicate test results to key stakeholders.

- Apply necessary project management and control policies and standards for emerging technology initiatives, including planning, scheduling, resource coordination, risk management, and performance monitoring.

- Lead the full project lifecycle from opportunity identification and assessment through development, demonstration, technology transfer, and closeout.

Strategic Partnerships, Industry Engagement & Communications

- Develop and implement partnership strategies that support Emerging Technology organizational objectives.

- Build and maintain effective working relationships with internal stakeholders, industry partners, startups, universities, venture capital firms, and other external organizations.

- Lead industry benchmarking efforts and integrate external insights and lessons learned into ETO strategy and innovation practices.

- Lead ETO support for regulatory filings and other external or internal communications requiring technology development information.

- Represent the company at customer forums, industry organizations, trade associations, and other external engagements while exemplifying what it means to be a Duke Energy employee

- Lead education sessions, including lunch and learns, seminars, and tours

- Demonstrate effective oral and written communication skills and maintain accurate project records, documentation, and files.

Innovation & Organizational Enablement

- Support the development and continuous improvement of innovation, project lifecycle, technology transfer, and portfolio management processes.

- Assess and prioritize R&D activities with other Lines of Business (LOB) and ensure they are aligned with their technology roadmaps and Duke Energy’s strategic objectives.

- Support required legislative and/or regulatory programs, documentation and filings to ensure successful implementation of pilots/programs (e.g. NC Non-DSM/EE Rapid Prototyping)

- Contribute technical and analytical expertise to the identification, analysis, and resolution of problems in areas of specialization.

Basic/Required Qualifications:

- Bachelor's Degree in Information Systems, Engineering, or Computer Science

- Minimum of 7 years of related work experience.

- In lieu of degree, a High School Diploma/GED and a minimum of 11 years of related work experience

Desired Qualifications:

- Understanding of fundamental engineering theories, principles, and practices, with the ability to interpret technical information and apply it to business and technology development decisions.

- Demonstrated experience conducting technology assessments, gathering and analyzing industry data, developing business cases, evaluation alternatives, and making data-driven recommendations.

- Strong understanding of technology trends and drivers shaping the future of the electric utility industry and their potential business, operational, and customer implications.

- Demonstrate ability to work independently and effectively manage project and initiatives with ambiguous or evolving objectives.

- Demonstrated ability to lead and facilitate cross-functional teams and collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders at all organizational levels.

- Demonstrated project management and project controls experience, including planning, scheduling, budgeting, resource coordination, risk management, and performance monitoring.

- Prior experience in utility planning, operations, or strategy, with an understanding of generation, transmission and distribution, and customer-facing business segments.

- Strong understanding of the utility regulatory construct and demonstrated ability to assess regulatory and policy considerations affecting emerging technologies.

- Excellent written, oral, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical and strategic concepts to diverse audiences.

- Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and related digital tools, including Excel, PowerPoint, Planner, SharePoint, Power BI, and Copilot.

Working Condidtions

- Normal office environment.

- Some field working conditions, including substation and distribution environments.

- Travel required 5-15%

- ​ Hybrid Mobility Classification – Work will be performed from both remote and onsite locations after the onboarding period. However, hybrid employees must live within a reasonable commute to their designated Duke Energy facility, not greater than 50 miles one way. Employees are expected to report to their assigned Duke Energy facility as required and directed by their manager, on average 3 full workdays per regular workweek.

Specific Requirement

- Valid Driver's License

- A Masters degree in Information Systems, Engineering, or Computer Science + 5 years related experience will be considered in lieu of the Bachelor’s in Information Systems, Engineering, or Computer Science + years related experience.

- A PhD in Information Systems, Engineering, or Computer Science + 3 years related experience will be considered in lieu of the Bachelor’s in Information Systems, Engineering, or Computer Science + 7 years related experience.

Travel Requirements
5-15%
